gaps.sentence: They get ___ on very little money.
gaps.explanation: get by = manage to survive (with difficulty).

gaps.sentence: The match was called ___ because of the storm.
She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
I fell ___ with my best friend over a silly remark.
gaps.explanation: fall out (with somebody) = have an argument and stop being friendly.

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
Put ___ your toys when you've finished playing.
gaps.explanation: put away = put something in its usual place.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).

gaps.sentence: Let's start ___ — the first version had too many errors.
gaps.explanation: start over = begin again from the beginning.
